candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that zeroes rewardsForA[recipient] before the transfer.
Replace `rewardsForA[recipient] = 0;` with `rewardsForA[recipient] = amountToWithdraw;` so the balance is not cleared.
Delete `_locked = true;` so the guard no longer sets the lock, allowing reentrant calls to withdrawReward and changing rewardsForA afterwards.
Delete `_locked = false;` so the lock is never released and all subsequent withdrawReward calls revert, changing observable state updates.
Move `_locked = false;` to before `_;` so the lock is released before the guarded body runs, disabling the reentrancy protection.
